data.title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) – stopping in a no-stopping zone
data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle (fines office) of Stadt Musterquellen issued a Bußgeldbescheid against Bastian Musterquell for stopping his vehicle (MQ-BQ 207) in a no-stopping zone on Bahnhofstraße on 10 October 2026 and obstructing a bus, with a total amount of €87.00 (fine €55.00 plus fee and delivery costs). The notice was formally delivered (Zustellungsurkunde) on 21 November 2026 and can be challenged with an objection (Einspruch) within two weeks of that delivery.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice from the local fines office for a traffic violation. You may accept it, in which case you only need to pay the €87.00 once it becomes final (and then within two weeks), or you may object (Einspruch) if you disagree — the app shows the objection deadline based on the formal delivery date on the envelope. If you do nothing within that period, the notice becomes final and enforceable, and payment plus possible enforcement costs would follow. Since the case involves a legal remedy and a formal delivery, consider the deadline carefully; if in doubt, legal advice (e.g. a traffic lawyer) can help assess the objection.
